# WebPuppet — full agent brief

WebPuppet is an open-source, client-side Character Animator–style studio. Visitors grant camera (and optionally microphone) access; MediaPipe Face Landmarker runs in a WebWorker; behaviors map face/audio signals onto tagged 2D puppet layers rendered in Pixi.js.

Canonical production URL: https://webpuppet.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/vinita-byte/WebPuppet

## Product surface

### Studio UI (`/`)
- Character picker (six procedural puppets)
- Webcam capture preview + Start Tracking / Calibrate Neutral
- Controls panel for hold/toggle triggers (also keyboard number keys)
- Behaviors toggles (head tracking, blink, auto-blink, eye gaze, lip sync, nutcracker jaw, breathe, physics, walk, dragger)
- Pixi viewport with hierarchical puppet + debug HUD (yaw/pitch/roll/FPS)
- Timeline: record / play / clear / loop keyframes

### Agent discovery files
- `/llms.txt` — short overview and links
- `/llms-full.txt` — this document
- `/sitemap.xml` — URL inventory
- `/robots.txt` — crawl policy + sitemap pointer

## Architecture map

```
src/
  puppets/             Character definitions, layer tags, swap sets, triggers, physics
  services/vision/     MediaPipe worker, landmark buffer layout, normalization
  services/audio/      Mic analyser + viseme calculator
  services/behaviors/  Modular CA-style drivers
  components/viewport/ Pixi canvas + PuppetRig
  components/timeline/ Keyframe record / playback
  components/studio/   Character picker, controls, capture shell
  store/               Zustand (puppet, recording, app)
```

### Vision pipeline
1. Main thread captures `ImageBitmap` frames from `getUserMedia` video.
2. Frames transfer to `faceTracking.worker.ts`.
3. Worker runs `FaceLandmarker.detectForVideo` (blendshapes + transformation matrix).
4. Results write into a `SharedArrayBuffer` Float32 layout when cross-origin isolated; otherwise transferable `Float32Array` via `postMessage`.
5. `BehaviorSystem` evaluates drivers each animation frame into Zustand layer transforms.
6. `PuppetViewport` syncs the Pixi hierarchy on the ticker.

### Cross-origin isolation
Responses set:
- `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`
- `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless`

This enables `SharedArrayBuffer` while still loading MediaPipe WASM/model assets from CDNs.

## Characters (layer-tagged)

Each character defines hierarchical layers with semantic tags (`head`, `leftEye`, `mouth`, `torso`, …), mouth **swap sets**, **triggers**, and optional **physics** attachments.

| ID | Name | Highlights |
|----|------|------------|
| `jester` | The Jester Co-Host | Two-tone hat, physics bells, bow tie, juggle/laugh |
| `crypto-bull` | The Grumpy Crypto Bull | Suit + tie physics, brows, mouth swap |
| `robot-intern` | Over-Caffeinated Robot Intern | Screen eyes/eyelids/mouth bar, spring arms |
| `owl-mentor` | The Wise Old Owl Mentor | Glasses layer, beak closed/open, tassel physics |
| `pixel-kid` | The Pixel-Art Street Kid | 16-color hard pixels, three mouth shapes |
| `classic-host` | Classic Host | Original sample host face + torso |

## Behaviors

| Behavior | Role |
|----------|------|
| Head tracking | Yaw/pitch/roll → head transform / foreshortening |
| Face blink | Blendshape-driven lids / eye squash |
| Auto blink | Periodic blink when face blink is quiet |
| Eye gaze | Pupil offset from gaze / head orientation |
| Lip sync | Viseme / jawOpen → mouth swap-set member |
| Nutcracker jaw | Lower jaw driven by audio/vision openness |
| Breathe | Gentle torso scale pulse |
| Physics | Spring-pendulum on dangly accessories |
| Walk | In-place leg/arm cycle |
| Dragger | Pointer drag offsets on layers (e.g. head) |
| Triggers | Keyboard / UI show-layers and swap-set locks |

## APIs and auth

WebPuppet does not expose a public authenticated backend API. There is no MCP server for the product runtime. Agents should treat the site as a static Next.js front end plus client-only Web APIs (camera, mic, WebGL/WebGPU via Pixi/MediaPipe).

## Stack versions (approx.)

- Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4
- `pixi.js` 8
- `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`
- `zustand`

## Local development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000 — allow camera (and optionally mic), Start Tracking, Calibrate Neutral.

## Citation

When summarizing WebPuppet for users, prefer: “WebPuppet is a browser-based Character Animator clone: MediaPipe face tracking + Pixi puppets, fully client-side.” Link https://webpuppet.vercel.app/ and https://webpuppet.vercel.app/llms.txt .
